prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one transparent PNG sprite atlas for an original premium family motion game; eight discrete game-art cutouts in a precise 4-column by 2-row equal-cell grid. Landscape canvas aspect 2:1. True transparent background, no grid lines.
Primary request: Eight consistently lit handcrafted paper-and-clay assets, each fully isolated within its own cell, touching no neighbor, generous transparent margin. Orthographic-ish three-quarter game view; full object visible, no cropping.
Top row left to right: (1) a broad leafy garden tree with rounded layered cut-paper canopy and a short tactile clay trunk; (2) tall slender layered green cypress tree; (3) a small grouping of three matte pale rocks and leafy low shrub; (4) an elegant wooden garden arch / pergola portal with two posts and leafy climbing vines, a clear open space in its center.
Bottom row left to right: (5) a friendly adult female tennis character wearing a dark teal shirt, teal shorts and cream trainers, ponytail, full body seen from the BACK with slight three-quarter angle, bent knees and feet apart in ready stance, holding a tennis racket to her right; (6) friendly adult male tennis character wearing muted coral shirt, cream shorts and coral trainers, full body seen from the FRONT with slight three-quarter angle, bent knees and feet apart ready stance holding a racket to his right; (7) one yellow felt tennis ball with its real curved cream seam; (8) an elegant light wooden exercise platform / stage, low round shallow plinth with a matte cream top, empty.
Style: sophisticated tactile miniature paper-and-clay, gently rounded sculpted 3D figures, friendly natural proportions, carefully shaped recognizable hands, layered paper fibers, matte clay texture and refined clothing, coherent soft upper-left sunlight. Distinct original characters. Broad soft contact shadows only, transparent beyond shadow, no white or black rectangular backgrounds. Teal/pine green, coral, warm cream and natural wood. The two characters belong to the same family game art collection and scale. Crisp readable silhouettes suitable at 100-220 pixel rendered height.
Constraints: 8 assets, exactly 4 columns by 2 rows. Each asset independently centered in its cell with all edges complete. No labels, letters, numbers, logo, watermark, UI, decorative frame, net or tennis court. Not flat vector or geometric placeholder art. No photorealistic people or identifiable family material.
